message: Hi, I'm a student with a machine learning certification background. My overall academic average is 72.8% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in Computer Architecture and developer. I want to become a Database Manager. My family can afford at most about USD 10700 per year. I live in Pune. I'd strongly prefer to stay near home, though I might consider elsewhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in Computer Architecture and developer roles

explanation:
This program is located in Pune, meeting your strong preference to stay near home. It requires a CS background and has a minimum grade requirement (70%) that you meet with your 72.8% average. The focus on Big Data Analytics aligns well with your interest in developer roles and database management.

Located in Mumbai, this program is a strong fit given its high placement rate (87%) and median starting salary ($13,436), which addresses your priority of securing a good job. It requires a CS background and has a minimum grade requirement (72%) that you meet.

This MCA program in Coimbatore offers relevant fields like software engineering and data science analytics. It is affordable ($1,350 tuition) and has a decent placement rate (83%), making it a solid option that meets your academic background requirements.

This MTech Data Engineering program is in Hyderabad, offering a good balance of affordability and job prospects. It does not require a CS background, which might be helpful, and its tuition ($1,550) is well within your budget.

This option in Delhi has the lowest tuition fee ($800), making it highly affordable and keeping you near major Indian metros. While its placement rate is lower, it meets your minimum grade requirement (63%) and provides exposure to Big Data Analytics.
